component.name: PlayerScene
component.script:
sub init() m.top.backgroundColor = "0x111111FF" m.top.backgroundUri = "" m.video = m.top.FindNode("video") m.video.ObserveField("state", "onState") m.retry = m.top.FindNode("retry") m.retry.ObserveField("fire", "play") ' Watchdog: the stream restarts with new segment numbers when its pod restarts, and the ' player can sit in "buffering" forever. If the position stops moving, reload. m.lastPos = -1 m.stalls = 0 m.watch = m.top.FindNode("watch") m.watch.ObserveField("fire", "onWatch") m.watch.control = "start" end sub
sub onWatch() if m.top.url = "" then return curPos = m.video.position if m.video.state = "playing" and curPos <> m.lastPos then m.stalls = 0 else m.stalls = m.stalls + 1 end if m.lastPos = curPos if m.stalls >= 2 then print "house-screen: stalled ("; m.video.state; "), reloading" m.stalls = 0 m.video.control = "stop" play() end if end sub
sub onUrl() play() end sub
sub play() print "house-screen: play "; m.top.url content = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") content.url = m.top.url content.streamFormat = "hls" content.live = true content.title = "House" m.video.content = content m.video.control = "play" m.video.SetFocus(true) m.top.signalBeacon("AppLaunchComplete") end sub
' The stream is live and never ends; if it errors or stops (pod restart, network blip), ' try again in a few seconds. sub onState() print "house-screen: state "; m.video.state; " "; m.video.errorCode; " "; m.video.errorMsg; " "; m.video.errorStr if m.video.state = "error" or m.video.state = "finished" then m.retry.control = "start" end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as String, press as Boolean) as Boolean ' Swallow OK/play-pause so the screen can't be paused by accident; Back/Home exit. return press and (key = "OK" or key = "play") end function
